limits: No original executable or plugin execution. Effective runtime hook ordering, live DEF resources, object placement collisions and allocation failures were not observed.

The ERA Pascal wrapper at71299e was inspected; its matching compiled function address in era.dll was not independently reconstructed. Artifact hashes identify the supplied pair, not proof that every source line maps to this exact build. No claim computed hooks/plugins absent.

UN:I calls into native4c9550/506570; complete final creation success, overlap policy, mutation atomicity and failure recovery are outside bounded pass. No invented flag1 success contract for creation.
Negative/overflow guard counts are possible through generic signed32 stores, but their full battle interpretation is outside scope. No generalized all-plugin behavior.
Raw PO nibble behavior is proved, but a complete campaign/save/plugin lifecycle is not. Source78 marker is one exact producer, not global provenance.
Native UN:E clamps coordinate probes; choosing stricter bounds in an adapter is an explicit adaptation, not exact invalid-coordinate parity.

The town-banner access test, object insertion, template and town-coordinate mapping, tile owner and extended guard record are not admitted by the placement kernel.
